info.title: Shillinq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the Shillinq application.

x-openregister.description: Shillinq — open-source business administration suite for Dutch SMB, ZZP, and government.

example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

GLTransaction.title: GL Transaction
GLTransaction.description: General ledger transaction header. Each posted transaction groups one or more balanced GLLine entries. Declared by bookkeeping-general-ledger (T1).

transactionNumber.description: Sequential transaction reference number, unique within an administration.

postingDate.description: Date the transaction was posted to the ledger.

periodId.description: Fiscal period identifier (e.g. '2026-06'). Determines which period's P&L/balance is affected.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction.

sourceReference.description: External reference (invoice number, bank statement ref, etc.).

journalEntryId.description: FK to the originating JournalEntry that triggered this transaction.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this transaction.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Transaction is being prepared; lines may be edited.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Transaction is locked; lines are immutable and affect period balances.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Transaction has been reversed; inverse lines were emitted automatically.

post.label: Post transaction
post.description: Lock the transaction and apply its lines to the ledger.

reverse.label: Reverse transaction
reverse.description: Emit inverse lines and mark this transaction as reversed.

GLLine.title: GL Line
GLLine.description: Individual debit or credit line within a GL transaction. T1 base fields (bookkeeping-general-ledger) + T4 dimension fields (bookkeeping-cost-centers-dimensions).

lineNumber.description: Sequential line number within the transaction (1-based).

accountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber. Must resolve to an active account.

side.description: Debit or credit side. Amount sign is always positive; side encodes direction.

amount.description: Non-negative monetary amount in the transaction's currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this line.

subLedgerType.description: Sub-ledger the line belongs to, for AR/AP/bank reconciliation.

subLedgerRef.description: Reference within the sub-ledger (e.g. invoice ID, bank statement ID).

costCenterCode.description: FK to CostCenter.code. Optional dimension tag per REQ-CC-003.

kostenDragerCode.description: FK to KostenDrager.code. Optional dimension tag per REQ-CC-003.

projectCode.description: FK to Project.code. Optional dimension tag per REQ-CC-003.

dimensions.description: Free-form key→value map for custom analytical dimensions. Each key MUST match a registered custom dimension register slug; each value MUST resolve to an existing record's code in that register. Validated via OR relations engine.

account.description: Chart-of-accounts entry this line posts to.

costCenter.description: Optional cost-center dimension tag for segment P&L.

project.description: Optional project dimension tag; required for WBSO time-per-project (REQ-CC-007).

segmentPnlByCostCenter.description: Segment P&L: sum of amounts grouped by (fiscalYear/periodId, accountNumber, costCenterCode). Consumable by launchpad widgets and manifest detail pages.

segmentPnlByProject.description: Segment P&L: sum of amounts grouped by (periodId, accountNumber, projectCode). Supports WBSO time-per-project via projectCode join per REQ-CC-007.

segmentPnlByKostenDrager.description: Segment P&L: sum of amounts grouped by (periodId, accountNumber, kostenDragerCode).

CostCenter.title: Cost Center
CostCenter.description: Analytical cost center (kostenplaats) for segment P&L, project accounting, and overhead allocation. Supports hierarchy via parentCode self-relation per REQ-CC-002.

code.description: Operator-assigned unique reference within the administration (e.g. 'KC-100').

name.description: Human-readable name for this cost center.

parentCode.description: FK to parent CostCenter.code for hierarchy navigation. Null = root node.

responsibleUser.description: Nextcloud user ID of the cost-center owner/manager.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this cost center.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable by existing lines but rejected for new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, queryable.

block.label: Block cost center
block.description: Prevent selection on new GL lines.

unblock.label: Unblock cost center
unblock.description: Re-enable selection on new GL lines.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive from active state.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state.

KostenDrager.title: Kostendrager
KostenDrager.description: Cost unit / cost object (kostendrager) for tracking costs per product, service, or contract per Dutch GAAP accounting practice. Shares the same shape as CostCenter; distinction is semantic per REQ-CC-002.

code.description: Operator-assigned unique reference within the administration (e.g. 'KD-001').

name.description: Human-readable name for this cost unit.

parentCode.description: FK to parent KostenDrager.code for hierarchy navigation.

responsibleUser.description: Nextcloud user ID of the cost-unit owner.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this cost unit.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Analytical project dimension for project-based accounting and WBSO time-per-project. Pre-positions WBSO time tracking per REQ-CC-007. Shares the same shape as CostCenter; distinction is semantic per REQ-CC-002.

code.description: Operator-assigned unique reference within the administration (e.g. 'PRJ-001').

parentCode.description: FK to parent Project.code for hierarchy navigation.

responsibleUser.description: Nextcloud user ID of the project owner.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this project.

timeBookingEnabled.description: Pre-positions WBSO time-per-project (REQ-CC-007). When true, time entries may be linked to this project for hours-per-project aggregation. The WBSO capability itself ships separately in T4-specialized.

active.label: Active
active.description: Selectable on new GL lines and time entries.

AllocationRule.title: Allocation Rule
AllocationRule.description: Cost-allocation rule that distributes shared costs (overhead, IT, facility) across cost objects using a named driver. Declared per ADR-031 as schema metadata — no AllocationService PHP class per REQ-CC-004.

sourceAccountPattern.description: Glob or range pattern matching the source account(s) to allocate from (e.g. '4900' or '4900-4999').

driver.description: Allocation driver determining how source amounts are spread across targets.

targets.description: At least 2 target entries. For fixed-percentage driver, percentages MUST sum to 100 (validated by x-openregister-lifecycle precondition on save).

code.description: Code of the target dimension object (CostCenter.code, KostenDrager.code, or Project.code).

source.description: Source reference for volume/headcount drivers (e.g. GL account or headcount source).

targetDimension.description: Which dimension type the targets[].code values refer to.

cadence.description: When the rule executes. per-posting → fires as x-openregister-lifecycle action on GLTransaction.post. monthly / period-close → fires via OR ScheduledWorkflow.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state. Seeds ship in 'paused' for operator review.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this rule.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of what this rule does and why.

active.label: Active
active.description: Rule evaluates on its configured cadence.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: Rule exists but does not execute. Default for seeded example rules.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical — rule is not evaluated and cannot be activated.

activate.label: Activate rule
activate.description: Enable the rule to execute on its configured cadence.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive
archiveFromActive.description: Permanently disable; rule history is preserved.

applyOnPost.description: When a GLTransaction is posted, evaluate all active per-posting AllocationRule records matching the transaction's lines. Emit additional balanced GLLine rows distributing the source account amount per the rule's targets and driver.
